name: gitsdk-mingw64-bin
description: Complete mingw64/bin directory from Git for Windows SDK - 37 Windows-native executables including curl, openssl, bzip2, antiword, pdftotext, compression utilities, HTTP/2 header tools, DNS utilities, and XML processors. These are x64 native Windows binaries that bridge the gap between MinGit (90 tools) and Full Git (416 tools), providing essential development and system utilities missing from the minimal MinGit installation.
